system.description:
This beautiful and strong song seeps into the blood of the wounded and weary, strengthening body and mind. When sung over an injured character, successes over the obstacle add dice to Health tests for the purposes of recovery.

Obstacle: Health of Wounded

Actions: 125

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 148
